title: dep-scan mcp coverage output
description: The document the coverage tool of `depscan mcp` returns: the scan directory's manifest stage entries, the reasons parts of the analysis did not run even though their stage completed, and the checks the scan did not run, or, when the report exceeds the server's response budget, the spill envelope with the file it was written to and the number of stages it holds. A skipped stage, a missing analyzer or a check that was turned off is reported here rather than left out. The two shapes are never mixed.

scanDir.description: The scan directory the coverage was read from, absolute and normalised, with / as the separator on every platform.

items.description: One stage entry of the manifest, with its status, reason, capabilities, analyzers and outputs.

stages.description: The manifest's stage entries, in the order the stages ran, check stages included. A scan directory without a manifest has an empty list.

items.description: One reason part of the analysis did not run.

notAssessedReasons.description: Every not-assessed reason the manifest records: a stage's notAssessed entries and each analyzer whose status is not-assessed, flattened so a reader does not have to walk the stages.

items.description: One check the scan did not run.

checksNotRun.description: The checks the scan recorded as not assessed, from the manifest's check-<name> stages. Empty when every requested check ran.

oneOf.title: the result spilled to a file

file.description: The absolute path, with / separators, of the file the result was written to, inside the scan directory's mcp/ directory. The file name is the tool name followed by the SHA-256 digest of the canonical arguments.

count.description: The number of stage entries the spilled coverage report holds.

stage.description: The name of the stage the reason belongs to, for example enrichment.

analyzer.description: The analyzer the reason belongs to, present when the reason comes from a stage's analyzer entries, for example atom or dosai.

reason.description: Why this part of the analysis did not run.

name.description: The check name, without the check- prefix the manifest's stage name carries, for example license or supply-chain.

reason.description: Why the check did not run.
